facts.text: East Hampton was founded in 1648 when colonial governors bought over 30,000 acres from the Montauk people and sold shares to New England settlers.

Over time, the South Fork evolved from farming, fishing, and whaling communities into a seasonal destination while historic streetscapes, churches, windmills, and maritime landmarks still define its character.
The now disbanded Clinton Academy on Main Street was the first chartered academy authorized by the New York State Board of Regents in 1784.
The house built in 1680 for Josiah Hobart, a prominent early settler, appears in the first formal deed of conveyance of East Hampton.
East Hampton experiences chilly, wet winters and very warm, dry summers, with the ocean moderating thunderstorms and keeping summer temperatures in check.
Past players have included John Irving, Norman Mailer, Kurt Vonnegut, Dustin Hoffman, President Bill Clinton, and singer Paul Simon.
